title: Sign-in field blocks paste or drop
fix: delete the onpaste/oncopy/ondrop handler so a password manager can fill the field

title: Password field is hidden from password managers
Identity field has no autocomplete token
fix: add the WCAG token, e.g. autocomplete="email" / "tel" / "postal-code"

title: Form control has no accessible name
fix: add <label for="id"> or aria-label on the control

title: Placeholder is doing the job of a label
fix: keep the placeholder as an example and add a visible <label for="id">

title: Interactive target is smaller than 24 by 24 CSS pixels
fix: raise the box to at least 24px, or leave 24px of clear space around it

title: The same information is asked for twice
fix: drop the confirm field, or let the browser auto-fill it from the first one

title: Focus outline removed with no visible replacement
fix: keep the outline, or style :focus-visible with a 2px visible indicator

title: Viewport blocks zoom
fix: remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport meta

title: Page language is not declared
fix: add lang="en" (or the page language) to the <html> element

title: Image has no alt attribute
fix: add alt="...", or alt="" when the image is decorative

title: Icon-only control has no accessible name
Positive tabindex overrides the reading order
fix: use tabindex="0" and let the DOM order carry the focus order

title: Click handler that the keyboard cannot reach
fix: use a <button>, or add role="button" plus tabindex="0" and a key handler

title: Focusable element is hidden from assistive technology
fix: remove aria-hidden, or take the element out of the tab order

title: Page refreshes or redirects on a timer
fix: remove the meta refresh, or let the user turn it off or extend it

title: Dragging with no single-pointer alternative
fix: add a move up/down button, and mark the element data-dnd-alternative

title: Invalid field does not point at its error message
fix: add aria-describedby="<id of the error text>" next to aria-invalid
